svg.title: Nexus AI — architecture
svg.desc: Nexus AI: AI-first healthcare platform · 4 roles · 6 languages. One platform for doctors, patients, pharmacy staff and admins, with an AI assistant that explains prescriptions in six languages but never prescribes.

svg.text: The AI may explain existing prescriptions only.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It never diagnoses or changes a dosage.

svg.text: A narrower assistant than an open-ended chatbot, in

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: exchange for safe behaviour in a medical setting.
